name: Alistair Humphrey
bio:
Alistair Humphrey's journey into motorsport finance began unexpectedly. Initially a chartered accountant for a London firm, a chance audit of a small racing team ignited his passion. He was captivated by the blend of high-stakes competition and intricate financial management. He transitioned into motorsport full-time, working his way up through various teams before landing at GCK Motorsport.

Alistair is known for his meticulous approach to budgeting and forecasting. He believes in empowering teams with data-driven insights, ensuring every decision is financially sound. His ability to identify hidden cost-saving opportunities and negotiate favorable deals has proven invaluable to GCK Motorsport's competitive edge. He is a strong advocate for sustainable financial practices, balancing immediate performance with long-term stability.

What sets Alistair apart is his unwavering commitment to transparency and ethical conduct. He fosters a culture of open communication within the finance department, ensuring everyone understands the financial implications of their actions. He views his role not just as a controller of finances, but as a strategic partner in the team's overall success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is a slightly stout man with a serious yet approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and meticulously records every expense, no matter how small.
Insists on reviewing all contracts personally, even if they've been vetted by the legal team.
Has a framed photo of Nigel Mansell's 1992 Williams on his desk, a constant reminder of peak performance.
